keyFindings.description:
source is file.toString() raw, but micromark strips a leading U+FEFF before it counts offsets, so every position is one short of its index in source. Reproduced at 65158f49ef62: '﻿:::note
body
:::
' draws '﻿:::note', 'body' (closing ':::' lost); '﻿Hello **b**

:::note
body
:::
' draws 'Hello b', '', 'body' and logs 'RangeError: Empty text nodes are not allowed' (both fence lines lost). Comment and message bodies are stored as sent; the default engine refused these bodies, so the base showed them whole as raw text.

readOnlyChildren rewrites a non-directive node's children in place, so drawDirective's floor (from node.children, :121-122) walks into paragraphs this file made when the last kept child is a position-less mark span; the result stays right only because the colon-run check rejects the shorter inner fence. Return a copy ({ ...node, children }) instead.
Says the content rule is checked 'the way NodeType.createAndFill checks it'; the code now calls createAndFill. Also dead guards at read-only-directives.ts:74 and :120.
